messages:
mohit: Kicked off a short 3-way GPU sweep (NA/EU/APAC) comparing cost+perf for embeddings and small-chat. Plots uploaded: https://s3.redwood/bench/1987654320/summary.png. TL;DR: L4 best latency, A10G best cost/throughput for embeddings at scale, T4 wins for cheap small-chat in eu region.

tara: Nice. Can you drop the main numbers? p50/p95, tokens/sec, and $/M tokens?

mohit: Sure — pulling from the run: 
- embeddings (512b avg): L4 p50=18ms p95=45ms tps=1200 $/M=38
  A10G p50=28ms p95=65ms tps=2400 $/M=22
  T4 p50=65ms p95=160ms tps=600 $/M=16
- small-chat (avg 64 tokens): L4 p50=9ms p95=22ms tps=3500 $/M=44
  A10G p50=14ms p95=35ms tps=4200 $/M=28
  T4 p50=22ms p95=80ms tps=1500 $/M=12
(quantized INT8 for T4 where noted)

julia: Where did you run KV cache offloading? IIRC EU runs had hotter host CPU and slower NVMe.

mohit: Good call — KV offload enabled on APAC and EU for L4 and T4, disabled on A10G (on-node NVMe). That explains the p95 tail on T4 EU. Notes in run meta: `kv_offload: true`.

nick: Any kernel differences? which matmul path used on L4 vs A10G?

mohit: L4 picked fused attention + cutlass kernels tuned for seq<=512. A10G used cuBLAS-accelerated matmul + attention kernel variant with fp16 path. T4 used int8 GEMM after quant. Small-chat used continuous batching with max_batch=16 on L4/A10G, 8 on T4.

sam: Did you try hybrid routing (emb on A10G, chat on L4) to optimize unit cost while keeping latency? Any routing policy numbers?

mohit: Yes — hybrid routing policy baseline: route embeddings to A10G, small-chat to L4. Observed blended $/M = 29 and p50 chat = 9.5ms, embeddings p50 = 28ms. Capacity footprint reduced by ~30% vs all-L4.

tara: Any quality regressions from quant on T4? eval set BLEU/embedding cosine?

mohit: Quick eval: embeddings cosine drop ~0.6% for INT8 simulated, negligible for downstream kNN recall@10 (~0.2% drop). small-chat LM perplexity up ~1.8% (human-readable slightly more fuzzy). Full eval artifacts: https://s3.redwood/bench/1987654320/evals.zip

julia: Do we have recommended knobs for customers? e.g., `batch_size`, `kv_offload`, `quant_mode` defaults per tier?

mohit: Draft recommendations:
- Hosted dev: prefer L4 for low-latency chat, batch_size=8, kv_offload=false, fp16
- Dedicated cost-saver: A10G for embeddings, batch_size=32, kv_offload=false, fp16
- Budget edge: T4 with INT8, batch_size=16, kv_offload=true, enable post-quant calibration

bench-bot: Automated note: sweep completed 1987654320 -> results archived. :white_check_mark:

tara: Awesome. @mohit can you add a small section to the public docs with the hybrid routing example and cost calc? I'll do a pass on wording.

mohit: Yep will PR later today with the routing snippet and a 2-node capacity example. Thanks all. :rocket:
